title: Python Development
description: Python programming covering syntax, data types, control structures, functions, data structures, OOP, exception handling, file handling, modules, and API development.
learning_outcomes: Write Python programs with proper syntax and indentation
Work with Python data types: strings, numbers, lists, tuples, sets, dicts
Implement control structures: conditions and loops
Create and use functions with parameters and return values
Handle exceptions and work with files and modules
